n: 4.7 Cu Ft. Top Load Agitator Washer with Extra Power and Pet Pro Option
desc: Boost your laundry cleaning power with the Maytag Top Load Washer with Extra Power and Pet Pro Option to break apart tough stains and filter out pet hair from your clothes. Maximize stain-fighting abilities by adding Extra Power to any wash cycle, including Quick Wash, for speedy, clean results, while knocking out wrinkles before they start with Wrinkle Prevent.
hl: Tackle large loads with 4.7 cu. ft. capacity, enough space to wash 19 towels at once.
The built-in water faucet rinses, spot treats or soaks clothes right in the washer—no extra steps needed.
Get more water when you want it with the Deep Fill option.
Extra Power option boosts stain fighting on any wash cycle with an intense pre-wash and extra agitation so you can walk away while stains wash away.
Two Extra Rinse options help ensure that messes and detergent are thoroughly rinsed away.
The Pet Pro Washer is engineered to remove loads of pet hair with the Pet Pro option and built-in Pet Pro Filter.
